extension.description: Surveille l'etat de la telecommande Bluetooth appairee (niveau de batterie via le service BLE standard) et notifie Kodi en cas de batterie faible. Voir docs/remote/decisions.md pour l'architecture et les limitations materielles connues.

Monitors the paired Bluetooth remote's state (battery level via the standard BLE service) and notifies Kodi on low battery. See docs/remote/decisions.md for the architecture and known hardware limitations.
